name: Glycogen synthesis and breakdown with their inherited defects
rationale: Members cover glycogen synthesis, glycogenolysis, glycophagy and the regulation of glucokinase feeding them, plus GYS1/GYS2, GBE1, GYG1, GAA, PGM1 and Lafora disorders; confusables instead carry glucose-6-phosphatase (GSD I) defects, glycolysis or glucagon/PKA signalling.

name: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and chromosome segregation
rationale: Nearly all members are meiotic DNA break formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex, cohesion, spindle and segregation steps; confusables are germline piRNA/zygotic programs, general DNA repair, or mitotic spindle and cohesion.

name: Common gamma-chain and beta-common cytokine STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are IL-2, IL-7, IL-9, IL-15, IL-21 (common gamma chain) and IL-3, IL-5 (beta common) signaling with STAT5 and lymphocyte/NK outputs; confusables center on IL-6/IL-10/IL-12 families, Th2/mast cell biology, inflammatory NF-kB or FLT3-driven STAT5.

name: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and tachykinin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are gastrointestinal, urinary, uterine and penile smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and reproductive acts, with tachykinin receptor signaling; confusables substitute histamine, serotonin, muscarinic or GnRH receptor signaling.

core: Forebrain radial glia and neuron migration
name: Forebrain radial glia and commissural axon tract formation
rationale: Members combine forebrain radial glial differentiation, radial-glia-guided migration and neuroblast division with corpus callosum, anterior commissure and corticospinal tract morphogenesis; confusables cover cortical lamination, interneuron migration or cerebellar development.

core: p53-driven G1 arrest and intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53-directed G1 arrest and apoptosis, with CDKN2A defects
rationale: Members are TP53 regulation and its transcriptional targets for p21-mediated arrest and PUMA/NOXA-driven apoptosis, plus p14ARF/p16INK4A defects; confusables are BCL2-family mitochondrial apoptosis execution or senescence/SASP programs.

name: MHC class II antigen processing and presentation
rationale: Members are antigen presentation modules and MHC class II exogenous peptide loading and regulation; confusables center on MHC class I cross-presentation, CD1 lipid presentation or immune cell surface signatures.

name: HNF4-driven absorptive brush-border epithelium identity
rationale: All modules but one describe HNF4A/HNF4G-specified absorptive brush-border epithelium of gut, liver and kidney tubule; confusables describe broader GI barrier epithelium (EPCAM, KLF5) or Wnt-driven crypt stem cells.

name: Glutamine-glutamate nitrogen metabolism and di-/tricarboxylate transport
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, aspartate metabolism, ammonium handling, the malate-aspartate shuttle and SLC13/SLC25 carboxylate transport; confusables are the urea cycle, TCA/gluconeogenesis or carnitine/cationic amino acid transport.

core: ER-Golgi vesicle traffic and Golgi organization
name: COPII and COPI ER-Golgi traffic and Golgi organization
rationale: Members are COPII export from the ER, COPI anterograde/retrograde and intra-Golgi traffic, plus Golgi ribbon assembly, disassembly and positioning; confusables cover post-Golgi lysosomal/endosomal routing and Rab regulation.

name: Cullin neddylation and COP9 signalosome deneddylation
rationale: Members are neddylation, deneddylation, COP9 signalosome assembly and a cullin-RING ligase substrate; confusables are general ubiquitination, deubiquitinases or PD-L1 degradation.

name: Androgen and estrogen biosynthesis and metabolism
rationale: Members are androgen and estrogen synthesis, testosterone regulation, androgen catabolism and aromatase (CYP19A1) deficiency; confusables are adrenal glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid synthesis and their CYP defects.

name: Presynaptic vesicle recycling and active zone cytoskeleton
rationale: Members are synaptic vesicle endocytosis, recycling, clustering and uncoating plus active zone and presynaptic cytoskeleton maintenance; confusables add clathrin assembly or postsynaptic receptor internalization.

qualifier: cerebellar layering and forebrain neuron specification
name: Regional brain development: cerebellar layers and forebrain neurons
rationale: Members span cerebellar granule/Purkinje layer formation, Bergmann glia, forebrain, striatum, thalamus and brainstem development with motor learning; confusables emphasize locomotor behavior or hindbrain/pons maturation.

name: Integrin adhesion with Rho-ROCK/PAK actin remodeling and spreading
rationale: Members are integrin/syndecan adhesion, Rho-driven ROCK/PAK activation, stress fibers, spreading, migration and platelet activation modules; confusables are fibronectin matrix, MET-FAK or ILK-PINCH focal adhesion assembly.

name: Fatty acid beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle and ketone bodies
rationale: Members are stepwise acyl-CoA beta-oxidation, carnitine synthesis/transport and ketone body synthesis/use; confusables are alpha-oxidation, short-chain/amino acid catabolism or branched-chain and cofactor disorders.

name: Presynaptic regulation of calcium-triggered vesicle exocytosis and plasticity
rationale: Members regulate synaptic vesicle priming, fusion and Ca2+-dependent exocytosis and short-term potentiation; confusables are transmitter-specific release cycles, docking/SNARE assembly, calcium channels or vesicle endocytosis.

name: Notch O-glycosylation and somite segmentation
rationale: Members are somite specification, axis elongation and Notch processing by O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation (LFNG, B3GALTL); confusables are Hox clusters, neural plate patterning, limb morphogenesis or Nodal left-right signaling.

qualifier: Sertoli barrier and sperm mitochondrial sheath
name: Germ cell development, Sertoli barrier and sperm mitochondrial sheath
rationale: Members follow germ cells from migration and meiotic entry to sperm mitochondrial sheath, with the Sertoli barrier; confusables cover Leydig/Sertoli proliferation, oocyte maturation or sperm motility.

qualifier: mesenchymal progenitor proliferation and matrix synthesis
name: Osteoblast and mesenchymal progenitor proliferation, differentiation and matrix
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, collagen/proteoglycan output, trabecular bone and tendon; confusables emphasize mineralization, RUNX2-driven ossification or BMP patterning.

name: Peroxisome protein import, fission and pexophagy
rationale: Members are peroxisomal matrix and membrane protein import, fission and pexophagy; confusables are peroxisomal lipid oxidation and synthesis.

name: Bacterial ligand sensing by NOD1/2 and TLR-MyD88/IRAK4
rationale: Members respond to peptidoglycan, muramyl dipeptide, lipopeptides, LPS and flagellin via NOD1/2 and TLR2/4/5 with MyD88/IRAK4 deficiencies; confusables cover TAK1-MAPK, LPS detection with chemotaxis, or the IPAF inflammasome.

qualifier: central and peripheral formation, maintenance, axon caliber
name: Central and peripheral myelin formation and maintenance, axon caliber
rationale: Members are CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance, Schwann cell initiation, OPC proliferation and neurofilament-set axon diameter; confusables are glial proliferation/gliosis or node-of-Ranvier assembly.

name: Leading-edge protrusion via actin severing, capping and turnover
rationale: Members are lamellipodium, ruffle and pseudopod formation driven by actin polymerization, severing, capping and depolymerization; confusables emphasize WASP/WAVE-Arp2/3 activation, macropinocytosis or actin crosslinking.

name: Epidermal cornification and desmosome-hemidesmosome adhesion
rationale: Members are cornified envelope assembly, skin barrier and keratinocyte development plus desmosome, hemidesmosome and anchoring fibril adhesion; confusables add laminin/integrin, cadherin or cardiac cell adhesion.
